limitation: Four independent blocks are an exploratory factorial probe, not confirmation or equivalence. Next-job starts bound prior publication only because there is exactly one worker. Exact publication, handler runnable readiness and CPU availability remain unobserved. Neither factor identifies an exclusive cause or proves a scheduler defect. No A/A arm or kernel observation is included; V19 repeatability does not qualify V20.
